title: On the Efficiency of Structured Pruning in Small Language Model Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2503.05920v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Companies that deploy generative language models on edge devices often need to train small models from scratch due to legal, data-governance, or product-customization requirements. An alternative approach is to train an enlarged model and compress it to the target size via structured pruning, but this advantage becomes unclear once the cost of pretraining the enlarged model is included. We introduce the enlarge-and-prune framework to study this question under full-cost accounting, and show that conventional enlarge-and-prune pipelines -- which train the enlarged model, prune it, and recover in separate stages -- do not consistently outperform direct small-model training under the same total token budget. To overcome this limitation, we propose IDEA Prune, an integrated enlarge-and-prune pipeline that unifies enlarged model pretraining, iterative structured pruning, and recovery under a single cosine annealing learning rate sche

translated_title: 论结构化剪枝在小语言模型预训练中的效率
translated_abstract: 在边缘设备上部署生成式语言模型的公司，出于法律、数据治理或产品定制化等要求，通常需要从头训练小模型。另一种方法是先训练一个放大的模型，再通过结构化剪枝将其压缩到目标尺寸，但一旦将放大模型的预训练成本计算在内，这种做法的优势就变得不明确了。我们引入了“放大-剪枝”框架，在全成本核算的条件下研究这一问题，并表明传统的放大-剪枝流水线——即分阶段地训练放大模型、剪枝并恢复——在相同的总token预算下并不总是优于直接训练小模型。为克服这一局限性，我们提出了IDEA Prune，这是一种集成式的放大-剪枝流水线，它在单一的余弦退火学习率调度下，将放大模型预训练、迭代结构化剪枝和恢复统一为一体。
tldr: 提出IDEA Prune集成式放大-剪枝流水线，在单一余弦退火学习率调度下统一放大模型预训练、迭代结构化剪枝和恢复过程，在全成本核算下比传统分阶段剪枝方法更高效地训练出小语言模型。
en_tdlr: We propose IDEA Prune, an integrated enlarge-and-prune pipeline that unifies enlarged model pretraining, iterative structured pruning, and recovery under a single cosine annealing schedule, enabling more efficient small language model training than conventional staged pruning pipelines under full-cost accounting.
